HANDWRITING ON THE WALL

IN PHOTOS: Motorists and pedestrians walked past a mural portraying workers’ struggles and urging higher wages and lower prices for basic commodities in Quezon City on Friday, May 1, 2026. Labor groups and human rights advocates observed Labor Day with a protest calling for a ₱1,200 living wage, an end to contractualization, and the scrapping of the regional wage rate system.

📸: Manny Palmero
